scenario_text: A mid-sized private bank currently runs its core banking system on a legacy COBOL framework. Management has decided to migrate the entire system to a modern Java-based framework. No new functionality is to be added — the migrated system must replicate the existing features exactly. Testing and validation is required at every stage of the migration to ensure nothing breaks. The project team consists of 2 developers and needs to be completed within 3-4 months.

requirements.statement: The system shall be migrated from a legacy COBOL framework to a modern Java-based framework
requirements.business_justification: Legacy COBOL framework is outdated and no longer supported; modern Java-based framework provides better scalability and maintainability
requirements.assumptions: Legacy COBOL code is available and accessible
requirements.acceptance_criteria: All existing COBOL functionality is replicated in the new Java-based system without introducing new bugs or errors

requirements.statement: The system shall undergo thorough testing and validation at every stage of the migration
requirements.business_justification: Ensures that the migrated system does not introduce any new bugs or errors, and that existing functionality is preserved
requirements.assumptions: Testing team has access to necessary resources and tools
requirements.acceptance_criteria: All testing and validation stages are completed successfully without any critical issues

requirements.statement: The system shall replicate the existing features exactly without introducing any new functionality
requirements.business_justification: Ensures that the migrated system meets the existing business requirements and does not introduce any new risks or complexities
requirements.assumptions: Existing business requirements are well-documented and understood
requirements.acceptance_criteria: All existing features are replicated exactly in the new Java-based system without any deviations or omissions

requirements.statement: The system shall maintain a version control history of all changes made during the migration process.
requirements.business_justification: The project team consists of only 2 developers and the project needs to be completed within 3-4 months, implying a high risk of errors or loss of knowledge if changes are not tracked.
requirements.acceptance_criteria: A Git repository is created and all changes are committed with meaningful commit messages, and a changelog is maintained.

requirements.statement: The system shall have automated regression testing to ensure that changes do not break existing functionality.
requirements.business_justification: The system has a large number of existing features that need to be replicated exactly, and thorough testing is required at every stage of the migration.
requirements.acceptance_criteria: A suite of automated regression tests is created and run after every change, with a coverage of at least 90% of the existing functionality.

requirements.statement: The system shall have a rollback mechanism in place in case of any issues during the migration process.
requirements.business_justification: The project has a tight deadline and a small team, implying a high risk of errors or issues during the migration process.
requirements.acceptance_criteria: A rollback plan is created and tested, with a maximum rollback time of 2 hours.

requirements.statement: The system shall have a monitoring and logging mechanism to track any issues or errors during the migration process.
requirements.business_justification: The system has a large number of existing features and a small team, implying a high risk of errors or issues during the migration process.
requirements.acceptance_criteria: A monitoring and logging system is implemented, with real-time alerts and a maximum error resolution time of 1 hour.

requirements.statement: The system shall have a performance and capacity plan in place to ensure that the migrated system can handle the existing workload.
requirements.business_justification: The system has a large number of existing features and a small team, implying a high risk of errors or issues during the migration process.
requirements.acceptance_criteria: A performance and capacity plan is created, with a maximum response time of 2 seconds and a maximum throughput of 1000 transactions per minute.

requirements.business_justification: The system has a large number of existing features and a small team, implying a high risk of errors or issues during the migration process.
requirements.acceptance_criteria: A data migration plan is created, with a maximum data migration time of 1 week and a maximum data loss rate of 0.1%.

sdlc.summary: The project is a core banking system migration, which is a long-lived infrastructure (PTR-5), and requires thorough testing and validation at every stage of the migration (REQ-002). The system shall be migrated from a legacy COBOL framework to a modern Java-based framework (REQ-001), and the system shall replicate the existing features exactly without introducing any new functionality (REQ-003).
sdlc.shortcut: Fixed scope + replacement of existing system + thorough testing -> V-Shaped
